stages.objective: Carry Kazzan's appeasement offer to Umar and Ubaid, then report.
Broker Arito's agreement with Muhad and report the peace.
Destroy Daniel Steelsoul's four spider-cult eggs.
Dig a preserved human bone from the cursed pit for Muriel.
Bring Muriel the recovered bone.
Place Jack's five used furniture kits in his home.
Break Jack's lizard statue with a pick after questioning his family.
Report to Spectulus and choose to tell Jack the truth.
Visit the five Loose Ends contacts in the chosen order.
Fetch holy water from Costello for Amanda.
Sanctify the fifteen unholy Edron graveyard graves.
Poison the Carlin sewer slime pool for Padreia.
Return to Padreia after the extermination.
Recover the special dwarven brown ale in Kazordoon.
Give Boozer the requested ale in Venore.
Report the completed chosen anthology to its nine patrons.
Ask Budrik for a mission and accept recovery of his stolen mining helmet.
Recover Budrik's stolen helmet from the existing Horned Fox hideout chest.
Return to Budrik and discuss the mission with the recovered helmet.
Record the chosen completed journey: Tibia Tales.
